title: Sava Gelaro S4 Экспресс обзор

takeaways.text: This entry GRX 2×10 build was bought through a grey importer in Russia for RUB 100,000 (September 2025) (Russian, automatic captions).

Carbon frame with thru-axles, flat-mount brakes, a threaded T47 bottom bracket, many accessory mounts, split headset spacers and an integrated aluminium bar-stem; the large round seatpost could take a dropper.
Touring-leaning geometry: short with a tall stack; the size L was clearly too small for the 187 cm mechanic.

Paint flaked at the edges of the brake mounts, and the rear axle hole was out of round with a flat axle seat, which he thinks may cause wheel-fit wear over time; the 140 mm rear rotor was also out of true.
The stock deep alloy wheels are heavy (rear over 1,100 g), not tubeless, and only 19 mm wide inside; he advises budgeting for new wheels and tires.
He estimates about 50 mm of usable tire at the rear and 47–48 mm at the front, above SAVA's 45C figure; 50 mm up front only for dry conditions.

disclosure: A Russian workshop's quick inspection of a customer's bike during assembly; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: Workshop inspection of a size L SAVA Gelaro S4 with Shimano GRX 2×10: frame details, faults found, wheels and realistic tire clearance (Russian, automatic captions).
